changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Seed one row per entity in job_schedules to avoid runtime insert contention on checkpoint updates
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sert_ingestor.job_schedules (entity_name, checkpoint_ts, initial_ts, updated_at, last_run_id) VALUES ('POSITION', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap'), ('POSITION_TOKENS', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap'), ('POSITION_TRANSFERS', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap'), ('EXTRA_INFO', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap'), ('EVENTS_WF', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap'), ('RECONCILIATION', NULL, NULL, now(), 'bootstrap') ON CONFLICT (entity_name) DO NOTHING;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM sert_ingestor.job_schedules WHERE entity_name IN ('POSITION', 'POSITION_TOKENS', 'POSITION_TRANSFERS', 'EXTRA_INFO', 'EVENTS_WF', 'RECONCILIATION') AND checkpoint_ts IS NULL AND initial_ts IS NULL AND last_run_id = 'bootstrap';
